# cross-chain — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Cross-chain bridge swap. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl cross-chain <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

### cross-chain bridges
List bridge protocols
`ocl cross-chain bridges [options]`
- `--from-chain <FROM_CHAIN>` — Source chain filter (name or chainIndex)
- `--to-chain <TO_CHAIN>` — Destination chain filter (name or chainIndex)

### cross-chain tokens
List bridgeable tokens
`ocl cross-chain tokens [options]`
- `--from-chain <FROM_CHAIN>` — Source chain filter (name or chainIndex)
- `--to-chain <TO_CHAIN>` — Destination chain filter (name or chainIndex)

### cross-chain quote
Get cross-chain quote (read-only)
`ocl cross-chain quote --from <FROM> --to <TO> --from-chain <FROM_CHAIN> --to-chain <TO_CHAIN> [options]`
- `--readable-amount <READABLE_AMOUNT>` — Human-readable amount (e.g. "1.5")
- `--amount <AMOUNT>` — Raw amount in minimal units
- `--slippage <SLIPPAGE>` — Slippage tolerance as **decimal**, range (0, 1] (e.g. 0.01 = 1%, 0.5 = 50%) (default 0.01)
- `--wallet <WALLET>` — User wallet address
- `--check-approve` — Have server compare on-chain allowance and fill routerList[].needApprove
- `--bridge-id <BRIDGE_ID>` — Pin a specific bridge id (openApiCode from quote / supported-bridges)
- `--sort <SORT>` — Sort preference: 0=optimal, 1=fastest, 2=max output (0|1|2)
- `--allow-bridges <ALLOW_BRIDGES>` — Allowed bridges (comma-separated bridge ids)
- `--deny-bridges <DENY_BRIDGES>` — Denied bridges (comma-separated bridge ids)
- `--receive-address <RECEIVE_ADDRESS>` — Destination receive address

### cross-chain approve
Build ERC-20 approve transaction for a bridge router (manual use)
`ocl cross-chain approve --chain <CHAIN> --token <TOKEN> --wallet <WALLET> --bridge-id <BRIDGE_ID> [options]`
- `--amount <AMOUNT>` — Approve amount in **smallest token unit** (raw integer, e.g. "500000" for 0.5 USDC at 6 decimals)
- `--readable-amount <READABLE_AMOUNT>` — Approve amount in **human-readable form** (e.g. "0.5" for 0.5 USDC)
- `--check-allowance` — Skip server allowance check (default: skip; pass --check-allowance to enable)

### cross-chain swap
Get unsigned cross-chain swap tx (calldata only, does NOT broadcast)
`ocl cross-chain swap --from <FROM> --to <TO> --from-chain <FROM_CHAIN> --to-chain <TO_CHAIN> --wallet <WALLET> [options]`
- `--readable-amount <READABLE_AMOUNT>` — Human-readable amount (e.g. "1.5")
- `--amount <AMOUNT>` — Raw amount in minimal units
- `--slippage <SLIPPAGE>` — Slippage tolerance as **decimal**, range (0, 1] (e.g. 0.01 = 1%, 0.5 = 50%) (default 0.01)
- `--receive-address <RECEIVE_ADDRESS>` — Receive address on destination chain (required for heterogeneous chain pairs)
- `--bridge-id <BRIDGE_ID>` — Pin a specific bridge id
- `--sort <SORT>` — Sort preference: 0=optimal, 1=fastest, 2=max output (0|1|2)
- `--allow-bridges <ALLOW_BRIDGES>` — Allowed bridges (comma-separated bridge ids)
- `--deny-bridges <DENY_BRIDGES>` — Denied bridges (comma-separated bridge ids)

### cross-chain execute
Execute cross-chain
`ocl cross-chain execute --from <FROM> --to <TO> --from-chain <FROM_CHAIN> --to-chain <TO_CHAIN> --wallet <WALLET> [options]`
- `--readable-amount <READABLE_AMOUNT>` — Human-readable amount (e.g. "1.5")
- `--amount <AMOUNT>` — Raw amount in minimal units
- `--slippage <SLIPPAGE>` — Slippage tolerance as **decimal**, range (0, 1] (e.g. 0.01 = 1%, 0.5 = 50%) (default 0.01)
- `--receive-address <RECEIVE_ADDRESS>` — Destination receive address
- `--bridge-id <BRIDGE_ID>` — Pin a specific bridge id (from quote.routerList[].bridgeId)
- `--route-index <ROUTE_INDEX>` — Pick a route by its zero-based index in quote.routerList[]
- `--sort <SORT>` — Sort preference: 0=optimal, 1=fastest, 2=max output (0|1|2)
- `--allow-bridges <ALLOW_BRIDGES>` — Allowed bridges (comma-separated bridge ids)
- `--deny-bridges <DENY_BRIDGES>` — Denied bridges (comma-separated bridge ids)
- `--mev-protection` — Enable MEV protection on the swap broadcast (EVM)
- `--confirm-approve` — Confirm and execute approve transaction (after user reviews quote)
- `--skip-approve` — Skip allowance check, go straight to swap (use after approve confirmed)
- `--force` — Force execution: skip backend risk warning 81362

### cross-chain status
Query cross-chain status
`ocl cross-chain status --bridge-id <BRIDGE_ID> --from-chain <FROM_CHAIN> [options]`
- `--tx-hash <TX_HASH>` — Source chain transaction hash
- `--order-id <ORDER_ID>` — Order id from a prior `cross-chain execute` (e.g. `swapOrderId`, `approveOrderId`)
